_comment: Invisible per-chamber singleton (v3.0). Tracks elapsed + spawn cadence timers + boss intro latch. Each chamber has its own instance (clock_outer/clock_foundry/clock_core) — destroyed and re-created at transition. siren_played + boss_killed retired in v3.0 (replaced by chamber transitions + world.all_levels_complete).

state_init._comment_spawn_count: live wave cap — spawners stop at spawn_count >= 30 so the arena doesn't grow without bound
